verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's own CLI can create databases and branches and run non-interactive SQL for agents. Its documented API and hosted MCP server, authenticated by service token, support headless agents. Together these cover creating a database and running queries, with schema likely applied as SQL DDL, all without the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of fetching or creating a connection string via CLI/API/MCP, a documented headless schema-apply flow (e.g. deploy requests from the CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent provisioning run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a database end to end — create it, fetch the connection string, apply schema, and run queries — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Create, delete and list your Vitess, Neki, and Postgres databases and branches
Run non-interactive SQL for agents and scripts (`pscale sql`)
The PlanetScale API allows you to manage your PlanetScale databases programmatically.
Use a PlanetScale service token to authenticate the hosted MCP server in CI, headless agents, and clients that send a custom HTTP header
The hosted MCP server provides access to database information and tools
